title: Thebes (No-amon)
lead: Thebes, the old southern capital of Egypt and the city of the god Amun, is called No or No-amon in the Bible. Assyria under Ashurbanipal sacked it about 663 BC, and Nahum 3:8-10 uses its fall as a warning to Nineveh.

sections.b: Jeremiah 46:25 and Ezekiel 30:14-16 name No in oracles on Egypt (Jeremiah's Plain English Translation has "Amon of Thebes"). Nahum 3:8 asks Nineveh, "Are you any better than Thebes?" and describes a city behind the Nile, with Cush, Egypt, Put and Libya as help, that still went into exile.
